guitar.modelsText: Gibson Les Paul / Gibson ES-175 / Telecaster
guitar.evidence: Slash's Gibson Les Paul (famously a Kris Derrig replica used on Appetite for Destruction) is iconic; Izzy Stradlin's rhythm work on Telecaster/other guitars is also documented.

tone.target: bright Slash-style Marshall crunch with singing sustain
tone.profile: bright Slash-style Marshall crunch with singing sustain
tone.summary: A classic Marshall crunch setup using the UK 45 model, paired with a bright cabinet and moderate delay for singing sustain and upper-mid bite.

rig.name: Guns N' Roses - Sweet Child O' Mine - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and background noise.
Provide the initial grit and bite for the classic crunch tone.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used to emulate a slightly broken-in, mid-focused overdrive characteristic of JCM/Marshall tones.

blocks.purpose: Add upper-mid bite and controlled crunch without excessive fuzz.
blocks.gap: The RAT is selected for its aggressive, mid-focused character, enhancing the 'bite' required for Slash's tone.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism and tonal depth by swapping the default IR for a more vintage/Marshall-specific model.

proposals.recommendedAsset: Vintage Marshall 4x12 IR (e.g., Celestion Greenback or British speaker profile)
proposals.reason: The current IR is generic; a vintage/Marshall-specific model will enhance the desired 'British' crunch and depth.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased tonal authenticity and warmth in the upper mids.
